meta.name: offensive-network-attacks
meta.description: Dense description covering ARP spoofing, LLMNR/NBT-NS/mDNS poisoning, DNS poisoning, MITM attacks, VLAN hopping, DHCP attacks, 802.1X/NAC bypass, IPv6 attacks. Tools: Bettercap, Responder, mitm6, Ettercap, Wireshark. MITRE T1557, T1040. Use when conducting internal network assessments or testing Layer 2/3 attack surface.

copy.tagline: 模拟网络攻击,找出内网安全漏洞
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你负责公司内网安全,想验证是否存在可被利用的攻击路径。
copy.tagline_en: Simulate network attacks to find security holes in your internal network.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you manage internal network security and want to verify possible attack routes.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 在内网渗透场景下会给出 ARP 欺骗、DNS 投毒、中间人攻击等第2/3层攻击的具体命令和操作步骤。
howto.when: 当用户要求进行内部网络评估、测试第2/3层攻击面，或提出执行ARP欺骗、DNS投毒等攻击时触发。

say.text: 帮我用 ARP 欺骗截获 10.0.0.50 的流量。
say.note: 让该主机流量经过你的设备。

say.text: 用 Responder 抓取内网主机的 NTLMv2 哈希。
say.note: 返回哈希值可尝试破解。

say.text: 对目标网段执行 VLAN 跳跃攻击。
say.note: 尝试进入其他隔离网段。

howto.what_en: Claude will assist in internal penetration testing, providing commands and steps for Layer 2/3 attacks such as ARP spoofing, DNS poisoning, and man-in-the-middle attacks.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user requests internal network assessment, testing the Layer 2/3 attack surface, or asks for ARP spoofing, DNS poisoning, etc.

say_en.text: Help me ARP-spoof 10.0.0.50 to intercept its traffic.
say_en.note: Redirects the host's traffic through you.

say_en.text: Use Responder to grab NTLMv2 hashes from internal hosts.
Run a VLAN hopping attack on the target segment.
